About — LAND 0 Skip to Content Home Print Collection Design Print Design Art Direction & Concept Trend Forecasting Events Clientele About Contact Open Menu Close Menu Home Print Collection Design Print Design Art Direction & Concept Trend Forecasting Events Clientele About Contact Open Menu Close Menu Home Print Collection Folder: Design Back Print Design Art Direction & Concept Trend Forecasting Events Clientele About Contact Who We Are At LAND , we create prints that feel both timeless and full of life. Our work blends a vintage-inspired sensibility with playful color, designed to be beautiful, versatile, and effortless to work with. Founded by artists Lindsay and Lily, LAND is a women-owned print design studio based in the Midwest. With over 13 years of collaboration, we bring a shared love of craft, color, and storytelling to every collection. Our designs often begin by hand — painted, drawn, or collaged — before being refined into polished digital artwork. We offer digital print assets in Adobe formats, and physical artwork upon request, ensuring our designs can be enjoyed in whatever form best suits your project. At our core, we believe great design should feel artful, approachable, and enduring. Lindsay and Lily met back in 2012 while working on the same team and have been work wives ever since. They love traveling together, hunting for beautiful vintage textiles, laughing at each other’s jokes, and going out for delicious meals. Check us out on Instagram @printsbyland hello@printsbyland.com © Copyright - LAND & LVR LLC - 2024 All rights reserved. No reproduction without permission.
